description: This file defines validation logic for Kubernetes OpenAPI schemas, including validation items for maps, arrays, primitives, and references, as well as factory functions for creating validation items based on YAML data types.

classes.name: validationItem
classes.description: Interface for schema validation items, extending proto.SchemaVisitor with methods Errors() and Path().

classes.name: baseItem
classes.description: Base struct implementing common error and path handling for validation items.

classes.name: mapItem
classes.description: Validation item representing a map in YAML, handling validation of map entries.

classes.name: arrayItem
classes.description: Validation item representing an array in YAML, handling validation of array elements.

classes.name: primitiveItem
classes.description: Validation item representing a primitive value in YAML, handling type validation.

methods.name: Errors
methods.description: Returns the list of errors for the validation item.

methods.name: AddValidationError
methods.description: Wraps and attaches a validation error to the item.

methods.name: AddError
methods.description: Adds a non-validation error to the item.

methods.name: CopyErrors
methods.description: Copies a list of errors into the item.

methods.name: Path
methods.description: Returns the path of the validation item.

methods.name: itemFactory
methods.description: Creates validation items based on the type of YAML data.
